title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: Master FOB Audience Cassette > Nak CM300 mics > Sony D5: master cassetteplayed back via a Nakamichi DR-1 > HHB 850 > EAC for DAE to Harddrive >CEP > CDWave > CDRWin > Yamaha CR8424 CDR

ai_review.summary: A lively audience‑recorded tape that captures a high‑energy ’82 Portland show with smoking Touch of Grey, Tight Estimated>Eyes, a soaring Spanish jam into The Other One and an unforgettable High Time.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid FOB capture – the crowd is front‑and‑center but still clear enough to enjoy the band’s performance.  Fans rave about the second set, especially Touch of Grey’s delicate lick, the tight Estimated>Eyes transition, the expansive Spanish jam into The Other One and a powerhouse High Time, while noting Jerry’s “on fire” guitar work and Phil’s thunderous space bomb.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars, praising both the musical performance (especially the second set) and the audience recording quality; only a few mixed comments lower the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe it as a crisp, clean FOB with clear crowd presence; some note minor imperfections (“sound isn’t par with show”) but overall the mix is listenable and captures the venue’s vibe.

poor_songs: U.S. Blues (mentioned by a few as a downer encore)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with solid jams; second set is highlighted for seamless transitions and high energy, especially the Touch>Woman Are Smarter sequence and the long Spanish jam into The Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly called "on fire", "rocked" and praised for a delicate solo lick in Touch of Grey.
band_member_comments.Phil: Active throughout, noted for “space‑bomb” during the second set and overall thunderous bass presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s 1982 country‑western piano sound is highlighted; noted that he had no mic but his playing still shines.
